versions.changelog:
claude-session v0.8.2

- No file changes detected in this version.
- Behavior and features remain consistent with the previous release.
Update cross-platform session management guide and rewind topic

claude-session 0.8.0

- Added skill dependencies: now depends on `cleanup` and `git-repo`.
- Removed obsolete `skill-card.md` (maintainability).
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md): dependencies section added.
- Minor content edits across topic files (compress.md, list.md, search.md) for clarity or freshness.

claude-session v0.7.1

- Updated "compress" topic to use MCP-direct via claude-sessions-mcp instead of UTCP/code-mode.
- Removed dependency on "utcp".
- Updated documentation across compress.md, import.md, repair.md, summarize.md, and main SKILL.md to reflect new backend and topic routing.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

claude-session 0.7.0

- Added new script: resources/session-id-inject.sh.
- Updated multiple Python scripts for session deduplication and repair.
- Improved session repair boundary handling in test-repair-compact-boundary.py.
- Removed skill-card.md from the repository.
- Documentation and changelog updates for improved clarity.

claude-session v0.6.0

- CHANGELOG.md updated with latest changes.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- No functional code or behavior changes.

claude-session v0.5.1

- Added explicit utcp as a dependency in SKILL.md (`depends-on: [utcp]`).
- Removed the legacy file: skill-card.md.
- Documentation improvements and updates to SKILL.md, CHANGELOG.md, and repair.md.
- No changes to session logic or user-facing commands.

claude-session 0.5.0

- Added topics: dual-sync (Windows/WSL memory path mapping) and memory-trim (MEMORY.md index byte-budget trim)
- New scripts: session-id-inject.sh, test-repair-compact-boundary.py, trim-memory-index.py
- Expanded topic matching and intent classification coverage in documentation
- Deprecated/removed: skill-card.md
- Updated guides and references for new features and scripts

claude-session 0.4.0

- Added clean-profanity topic for in-place sanitation of profanity tokens in session JSONL files.
- Updated SKILL.md to include clean-profanity in topic list and description.
- Introduced guidance to avoid ambiguous argument parsing; now prompts user to clarify intent if input could match several topics.
- Removed skill-card.md and refreshed documentation for accuracy.
- Ensured that non-matching topics or unclear requests do not fall back silently to rename, improving reliability of topic dispatch.

claude-session v0.3.1

- Improved topic dispatch: when called with a topic, only the matching topic file is loaded and used, without echoing or summarizing unrelated topics.
- Clarified guidance in SKILL.md about user-facing responses to prevent extraneous topic summaries.
- Removed non-essential file: skill-card.md.
- Documentation refinements for accuracy and focus in topic usage.
- No functional command or interface changes; update is organizational and clarifies behavior.

claude-session v0.3.0 introduces new features, major topic additions, and structural improvements.

- Added session archive, list, search, and install commands with scripts and documentation.
- New archive functionality moves sessions out of active project to backup storage.
- list command allows enumeration of sessions by project, with summary and filtering options.
- install topic for setup of session-id-inject hooks.
- Enhanced search: distinct from keyword-only ID search, now with validation and metadata checks.
- Expanded documentation for all commands and updated session management topics.
- Deprecated and removed obsolete skill-card.md.

- Removed support for search and install commands; ID command now integrates keyword search functionality.
- Updated session move syntax: can now move multiple session IDs at once in a single command.
- Cleaned up SKILL.md and guides to reflect new command syntax and removed deprecated commands/scripts.
- Dropped several auxiliary scripts and documentation files (search.md, install.md, scripts/classify-sessions.py, move-session.py).
- Refined project structure and documentation, clarifying requirements and session management workflows.
Add hook-based session ID injection for fast lookup, plus new topics: install (skill installation), search (keyword session search). Address CodeRabbit review feedback from PR #5.
Add no-arg marker generation in find-session-id.sh, fix path_to_project_name to match Claude Code source (regex + base36 truncation)
Add move topic for session relocation by ID, add API 400 error detection to repair
Initial release: id, import, summarize, analyze, classify, compress, destroy, migrate, repair, rename, url
